//: Deskhand declarative config. Place as deskhand.json beside the exe, in the working directory, or at %PROGRAMDATA%\Deskhand\deskhand.json — or point DESKHAND_CONFIG at any path. A real DESKHAND_* environment variable always overrides the matching value here. Keys may be friendly (camelCase) or full env names (DESKHAND_PORT); booleans map to 1/0. Remove the keys you don't need.
